name: BMW R1100S
engine: 1085 cc air/oil-cooled boxer twin, fuel injected, shaft drive
intro: BMW's sporty oilhead. Fuel injected boxer, shaft drive and a single-sided swingarm.

H: Boxer twins need the valve clearance checked on both sides and the throttle bodies synced. Do both at the same service.

recallNote: BMW has issued several recalls across these years. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start.
